lines.en: I tap on Maki's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Maki 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: : I don't want to be Porn Guy. I don't like that name.
lines.zh: : 我可不想当黄片男。我不喜欢那个名字。

lines.en: : But I am Porn Woman. There needs to be a Porn {i}Guy.{/i} That's the rule.
lines.zh: : 可我是黄片女啊。那就得有个黄片{i}男{/i}。这是规矩。

lines.en: : I have never heard of this rule before, but I guess it doesn't matter.
lines.zh: : 这规矩我以前可从没听说过，不过我想也无所谓。

lines.en: : Are you doing anything right now?
: Nope! Want me to come over and terrorize your [niece]?
lines.zh: : 没有！要不要我过去折腾折腾你的 [niece]？

lines.en: : Or just, you know, hang out with me and not get Ami involved.
lines.zh: : 或者，你懂的，就单纯跟我待着，别把 Ami 牵扯进来。

lines.en: : Works for me! I'll head over now.
lines.zh: : 我没意见！那我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Cool. Just take your time and don't get there before me again.
lines.zh: : 好。慢慢来就行，别又比我先到。

lines.en: : In case you're wondering, no. I did not bring the lube this time.
lines.zh: : 你要是想知道的话——没有。这次我没带润滑液。

lines.en: : In case you're wondering, no. I did not bring any lotion this time.
lines.zh: : 你要是想知道的话——没有。这次我什么乳液都没带。

lines.en: : Looks like you're going to have to choose what we do, [makimaster].
lines.zh: : 看来这次得由你来决定我们做点什么了，[makimaster]。

lines.en: How should I spend my time with Maki?
lines.zh: 我要怎么和 Maki 度过这段时间？
